capabilities: : Create new notes in selected folders
intentEvidence: Stock Obsidian only expands/collapses a folder when you click its name, with no lightweight way to say "I'm working in this folder."
motivation: Stock Obsidian only expands/collapses a folder when you click its name, with no lightweight way to say "I'm working in this folder."
problem: Stock Obsidian only expands or collapses a folder when clicked, lacking a lightweight way to indicate which folder is currently being worked in.
summary: Select Folder provides Finder-like behavior in the file explorer, allowing users to select folders by clicking them and automatically placing new notes within the selected directory.
